meta_description: Handley Electrical are experienced electricians in Nottingham. From rewires to safety testing, we deliver reliable installations. Call 07725 515708 today.
hero_subhead: From faulty wiring to full rewires, we fix electrical problems fast and safely. Same-day appointments available.
services_subhead: Whether you need a socket rewired, a full house upgrade, or urgent fault finding, we've got you covered.

services.title: Complete House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring poses a fire risk. We strip out outdated cables and install new circuits to modern standards, bringing your home safely up to code. Every job comes with an EICR certificate.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping switches, dead sockets, flickering lights — we diagnose the cause quickly and fix it right. Most jobs completed on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Control Installation
services.desc: New boiler needs a compatible control system? We install and wire heating controls, timers, and smart thermostats to maximise efficiency.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Certification
services.desc: Landlords and homebuyers need an EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Report). We carry out full safety testing and provide the formal certificate you need.

services.title: Shower Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: From electric showers to powerful rain heads, we handle the wiring, earthing, and installation. Includes safety testing before handover.

services.title: Garden & Outdoor Electrics
services.desc: New garden lights, outdoor sockets, or EV charging? We design and install weatherproof systems with proper IP ratings and RCD protection.

about_pullquote: We do the job right because we live here too.
about_para_1: Handley Electrical was founded in 2009 by Mark Handley, a NICEIC-trained electrician frustrated by cowboys undercutting proper work. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for honest, skilled installations across Nottingham. We don't cut corners, we don't overcharge, and we back every job with written certification.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords come back to us because we answer the phone, we turn up on time, and we explain what needs doing before we start. We've completed over 2,000 installations — from urgent fault fixes to full rewires — and we treat every home with the same care we'd give our own.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Handley Electrical

reviews.text: Mark came round for an EICR on our rental and found some dodgy wiring we'd missed. Fixed it all the same week, very thorough, didn't try to sell us stuff we didn't need. Proper job. Will use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Our bathroom light kept tripping the RCD. Called on Thursday, Mark came Friday morning and sorted it in 30 mins. Turned out it was a water issue, not the circuit. So glad we didn't just poke around and make it worse. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sophie M.

reviews.text: Had a full house rewire done last summer. Mark was upfront about the cost, explained everything as he went, left the place clean. Got the certification straight away. Far better than the other quotes we got. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Paul K.
